metadata.title: Reborn Before the Auction Betrayal
metadata.subtitle: My husband mortgaged my late mother’s art gallery to pay his mistress’s debts, then staged a studio fire. I woke up at 6:30 PM on auction night.

nodes.text: 6:30 PM · Smoke fades from your throat. You’re standing inside your late mother’s art gallery—ninety minutes before Sebastian auctions a forged canvas and torches the vault.
Guests arrive at 7, honey! Camille already crated your mother’s "Midnight Lotus" painting for Lot 12.
Lot 12 isn’t my mother’s painting. It’s a $500 replica while the real canvas is in Camille’s trunk.
Sebastian, make sure the basement oil rags catch fire right after Lot 12 sells for $6M!

nodes.transcript: [hushed voice] "Miss {{player_name}}, I’m Leo from Sovereign Appraisals. I just UV-scanned Lot 12 backstage—the varnish is less than a week old!"

nodes.prompt: Camille wheels the crated forgery toward the auction stage:

options.label: Have Leo secretly tag the real canvas in her car
options.player_reply_text: Don’t stop Lot 12 yet, Leo—let’s track where Camille moves my mother’s real painting.

options.label: Swap the fake back with a blank "FRAUD" canvas

nodes.text: Leo slips a micro-GPS tag onto Camille’s trunk latch in the loading alley.
Tracker active! And I found two cans of turpentine hidden by the basement boiler!
You quietly swap Lot 12’s velvet-draped easel with a canvas stamped "CHECK CAMILLE’S TRUNK — REAL LOT 12 INSIDE."
Oh, this unveil is going to shatter Sebastian’s whole career in one second!
Crystal chandeliers glow as 150 billionaire collectors take their seats.
Welcome everyone! Tonight’s crown jewel—Lot 12—starts bidding at $3 million!

nodes.headline: Lot 12 Unveiled
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Velvet Reveal — The auctioneer pulls the crimson velvet cord on Lot 12.

nodes.text: 7:15 PM · The auctioneer pulls the crimson velvet cord on Lot 12. Sebastian grins—until the entire room gasps.
What is this joke?! Camille, who touched the easel before we went onstage?!
Relax, Sebastian. Why don’t we ask security to open Camille’s white Mercedes in the alley?
Move my car NOW!! Give the valet $5,000 to drive it off the block!!

nodes.transcript: [live audio from alley] "Too late, Camille! Two art-crime detectives just opened your trunk—and pulled out the genuine Midnight Lotus!"

nodes.prompt: Collectors stand up furious, demanding to know if Sebastian tried to sell them a forgery:

options.label: Walk onstage & display the real canvas yourself
options.player_reply_text: My mother’s real painting is safe—and my husband’s curator was smuggling it out the back.

options.label: Play Camille’s basement arson text on screen

nodes.text: Leo carries the authentic Midnight Lotus onstage under spotlight as cameras flash wildly.
Camille acted completely alone!! I had no idea she swapped the crate!!
You project the turpentine photos AND Camille’s text naming Sebastian straight onto the auction bid screen.
Turn off the projector!! That text is faked!!
Two detectives step smoothly onto the auction floor—stopping Camille at the side exit.
Don’t pin this on me, Sebastian! You’re the one who mortgaged {{player_name}}’s gallery for $4 million!

nodes.headline: The Hidden Mortgage
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Vault Ledger — You remember the vault code from your past life: 0419—Camille’s birthday.

nodes.text: 7:45 PM · You remember the vault code from your past life: 0419—Camille’s birthday. Inside Sebastian’s private safe sits the black ledger proving every stolen sale.
Sebastian just slipped into his upstairs office while police are questioning Camille downstairs!
He’s going for the wall safe behind the portrait. Beat him to the door!
Once I burn the black ledger, nobody can tie the private mortgage to me!

nodes.transcript: [knocking loudly] "Office door is bolted from inside—and I smell lighter fluid under the crack!"

nodes.prompt: You reach the upstairs office holding the spare brass fire key:

options.label: Unlock & douse the metal wastebasket
options.player_reply_text: Drop the lighter, Sebastian—destroying evidence adds five years!

options.label: Trigger the office overhead sprinkler first

nodes.text: You kick the door open and snatch the unburned black ledger straight out of his hands.
Give that back! That’s my personal business journal!!
Cold water pours from the ceiling sprinkler—drenching Sebastian and killing his lighter before a single page chars.
My Italian suit!! You soaked the whole office!!
You flip open the dry pages of the black ledger—finding six forged collector receipts totaling $4.8 million.
Look at the final page—Sebastian already scheduled a $2.5M wire from the gallery escrow at 8:30 PM tonight!

nodes.headline: Thirty Minutes To The Wire
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The 8:30 PM Wire — Sebastian set an automated 8:30 PM wire draining your gallery’s entire reserve into an offshore art broker’s account..

nodes.text: 8:10 PM · Sebastian set an automated 8:30 PM wire draining your gallery’s entire reserve into an offshore art broker’s account.
Here’s the pending transfer screen from the gallery’s accounting tablet—$2.5M queued to leave in 15 minutes!
Cancel it with my owner token—and trace which broker owns that IBAN.
Tell my broker to confirm receipt at 8:31 PM even if I’m in police questioning!

nodes.transcript: [relieved cheer] "Wire canceled with 4 minutes left! And the bank flagged the receiving IBAN—it belongs to Camille’s brother in Monaco!"

nodes.caption: Scheduled $2.5M gallery escrow wire — halted four minutes before release to Camille’s brother’s offshore account.

nodes.prompt: Sebastian demands his lawyer tell police the gallery belongs half to him:

options.label: Show your mother’s sole-heir trust deed
options.player_reply_text: My mother’s gallery is separate pre-marital property, Sebastian. You own zero percent.

options.label: Add unauthorized wire fraud to his arrest sheet

nodes.text: Sebastian’s lawyer reads your mother’s deed and quietly closes his briefcase.
Wait—you’re not taking my case?! I’ll pay double!!
The prosecutor upgrades Sebastian’s charges to federal wire fraud and attempted arson—raising his bail to $2 million.
Two million bail?! Nobody’s going to lend me that!!
Downstairs, the art collectors applaud as the authentic Midnight Lotus sells legitimately for $6.8 million.
Wait—Camille’s brother in Monaco just texted her phone threatening to expose three OTHER forged paintings Sebastian sold last year!

nodes.headline: Three More Forgeries
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Forgery Ring — Next morning.

nodes.text: 9:30 AM · Next morning. If collectors discover Sebastian sold three fake masterpieces under your mother’s gallery name, your reputation dies overnight.
I cross-checked the black ledger—three private buyers paid $1.2M each for fakes painted by an underground forger named Dante.
Let’s contact all three collectors FIRST, refund them from Sebastian’s seized assets, and track down Dante.
Tell my brother to burn Dante’s studio in the warehouse district before the cops trace the canvas!

nodes.transcript: [urgent tone] "One collector just agreed to cooperate—and he gave us the exact delivery van plate that brought his painting!"

nodes.prompt: Police trace the delivery van to an old loft on 4th Street:

options.label: Notify the collectors transparently right now
options.player_reply_text: We’re replacing every fake with restitution—and putting the real culprits in jail.

options.label: Send Leo & police to raid Dante’s loft first

nodes.text: All three collectors praise your rare honesty—refusing to sue your mother’s gallery.
Your integrity just saved a forty-year family name!
Detectives breach the 4th Street loft, seizing twelve unfinished forgeries AND Sebastian’s signed commission checks.
Dante flipped immediately—he handed over every email from Sebastian!
Instead of a scandal, art magazines hail you as the whistleblowing heiress cleaning up the auction market.
Hold on—Dante says Sebastian actually stole ONE genuine painting from your mother’s private vault six months ago!

nodes.headline: The Missing Masterpiece
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Stolen Portrait — Your mother’s final self-portrait—priceless to you—is missing from Vault 2.

nodes.text: 2:15 PM · Your mother’s final self-portrait—priceless to you—is missing from Vault 2. Sebastian pawned it to a ruthless private collector.
Found it! Sebastian pledged your mother’s self-portrait to Baron Krell’s private vault in exchange for a $900K cash loan.
He sold my mother’s last painting to buy Camille a yacht.
Krell will never hand over that portrait—he doesn’t care about court orders!

nodes.transcript: [determined voice] "Good thing Krell’s holding stolen property. Police just signed a cross-jurisdiction search warrant for his villa!"

nodes.prompt: Baron Krell’s lawyer calls offering to sell YOUR own mother’s painting back to you for $1.5M:

options.label: Refuse ransom & serve the seizure warrant
options.player_reply_text: That painting is documented stolen property. Hand it over or face felony receiving charges.

options.label: Threaten to expose Krell’s other smuggled art

nodes.text: Krell’s lawyer folds in ten seconds flat—opening the private vault to detectives.
Your mother’s self-portrait is wrapped, unharmed, and on its way back to you!
Leo mentions two smuggled Renaissance bronzes Krell hides—making Krell personally courier your portrait back within the hour.
He didn’t even ask for a dime back from Sebastian—he’s terrified!
Tears well up as you unwrap your mother’s smiling self-portrait—safe in your hands once more.
Wait—gallery security just called. Someone broke into the museum basement tonight—same place the turpentine cans were hidden!

nodes.headline: Return To The Basement
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Accomplice’s Move — Camille’s brother flew in from Monaco—determined to burn your gallery so the original evidence crates disappear before trial..

nodes.text: 9:45 PM · Camille’s brother flew in from Monaco—determined to burn your gallery so the original evidence crates disappear before trial.
Basement motion sensors tripped at 9:43 PM! The hallway camera looks suspiciously clear—he might be using a signal jammer!
Lock the basement steel blast-door from the fire panel and call 911!
Tell my brother to abort—the gallery upgraded its locks after auction night!!

nodes.transcript: [rain drumming outside] "Police cruisers are 90 seconds away! I’m sealing the freight elevator so nobody gets up to the main gallery!"

nodes.text: [whispering urgently] "Camille’s brother just bypassed the service keypad and headed straight for the climate vault! Tell me you’ve got the silent alarm armed!"
Camille’s brother just bypassed the basement keypad and is heading for the vault—hit the silent alarm!

nodes.prompt: The intruder bangs against the locked freight elevator from the basement:

options.label: Keep the basement sealed until police breach
options.player_reply_text: Stay right there—police are coming down the stairwell now.

options.label: Flood the basement stairwell with bright sirens

nodes.text: Officers descend the concrete steps and arrest Camille’s brother holding a blowtorch.
Caught with a Monaco passport and a blowtorch—zero chance of bail!
Piercing sirens and strobes disorient him completely until officers cuff him beside the boiler.
Not a single canvas upstairs was even touched!
That was the final attempt to burn your mother’s legacy. Every conspirator is now behind bars.
Wait—while resetting the basement camera, I noticed something weird on the 9:43 PM loop file...

nodes.headline: The Missing Minute
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Ghost Frame — Leo checks the basement camera server—discovering the intruder didn’t work alone.

nodes.text: 10:30 PM · Leo checks the basement camera server—discovering the intruder didn’t work alone. An old gallery night guard sold him the jammer code.
Look at the empty-hallway frame injected onto Cam 4—the metadata timestamp matches the night guard’s personal phone!
Let’s pull his shift log. He was on duty the night my mother’s portrait vanished too.
Pay the night guard $10,000 cash to loop Cam 4 whenever we move crates!

nodes.transcript: [crisp voice] "Detectives just questioned the night guard—he folded immediately and turned over Sebastian’s cash envelope!"

nodes.caption: Basement Vault Cam 4 · 21:43 — static empty hallway frame looped by the bribed night guard during the break-in.

nodes.prompt: With the final mole caught, you audit your gallery’s entire security system:

options.label: Switch the entire vault to biometric locks
options.player_reply_text: Zero human shortcuts from today on—every vault requires my live scan.

options.label: Name Leo Head of Security & Appraisals

nodes.text: Technicians install dual-encrypted biometric doors across all three vault levels before dawn.
Fort Knox couldn’t crack this gallery now!
Leo grins warmly and shakes your hand—accepting the dual role on the spot.
Protecting your mother’s masterpieces is my dream job, {{player_name}}.
Every leak plugged, every painting home, every traitor indicted.
Your divorce and criminal restitution hearings are both set for Friday morning.

nodes.headline: Friday Reckoning
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Divorce Decree — Family Court.

nodes.text: 9:00 AM · Family Court. The judge grants immediate annulment for fraud and awards you full ownership of the gallery plus $3M in restitution from Sebastian’s estate.
Done and stamped! Sebastian doesn’t get a single brushstroke of your mother’s legacy.
Next stop: the criminal courtroom across the hall.
Wait—{{player_name}}, don’t turn your back on five years of marriage!!

nodes.transcript: [steady voice] "Five years of him forging your mother’s life work behind your back. Let’s go hear the sentences."

nodes.prompt: Sebastian tries to catch your eye from the defendant bench:

options.label: Look straight ahead at the judge’s bench
options.player_reply_text: I have nothing left to say to a man who tried to burn my mother’s memory.

options.label: Read your victim impact statement aloud

nodes.text: Your calm dignity fills the courtroom as the judge slams the gavel: 16 years for Sebastian, 12 for Camille.
Sixteen years—and full asset forfeiture!
Your quiet, devastating statement moves the gallery of reporters to silence—sealing maximum sentences for all four conspirators.
Not a dry eye in the front row. You honored your mother perfectly.
You step out of the courthouse into crisp autumn air—completely free.
The Grand Re-Opening Exhibition is next Saturday. Ready to hang Midnight Lotus back in the center hall?

nodes.headline: The Centerpiece Returns
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: The Re-Opening Gala — Exactly one month since the night you woke up before the fire.

nodes.text: 6:30 PM · Exactly one month since the night you woke up before the fire. Your mother’s gallery glows with warm museum lighting and 300 genuine patrons.
Look at the crowd around your mother’s self-portrait—every critic in town is calling this the revival of the decade!
Zero fakes, zero turpentine, and zero liars in the room tonight.
I heard the re-opening sold out. Your mother’s art really was irreplaceable.

nodes.transcript: [soft smile] "Three museums just requested a world tour for Midnight Lotus. Your mother’s name is going global!"

nodes.prompt: Leo hands you a microphone for the opening toast:

options.label: Dedicate the gallery to young honest artists
options.player_reply_text: True art survives every fire. Welcome back to my mother’s gallery!

options.label: Thank Leo publicly for standing by the truth

nodes.text: Warm applause echoes beneath the skylights as your mother’s portrait shines in the center.
Your mother would be beaming right now, {{player_name}}.
Leo blushes slightly under the gallery lights, lifting his glass straight to you.
Best partnership I’ve ever signed up for!
The clock strikes 7:00 PM—not a spark of smoke, only golden applause.
One last surprise: I saved two seats on the balcony for after the crowd leaves.

nodes.headline: Midnight Lotus Blooms
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: After The Crowd Leaves — The grand hall settles into peaceful quiet.

nodes.text: 10:15 PM · The grand hall settles into peaceful quiet. You stand beside Leo beneath Midnight Lotus, admiring every real brushstroke.
You know, I still don’t know how you spotted Camille’s swap before anyone else on auction night.
Call it a mother’s warning—and a second chance I refused to waste.
Take care of the gallery, {{player_name}}.

nodes.transcript: [gentle laugh] "Whatever it was, I’m glad I was holding that UV lamp at 6:30 PM."

nodes.prompt: Leo holds out two tickets to the Paris museum tour opening:

options.label: Take your ticket & smile at the new chapter
options.player_reply_text: Paris sounds lovely, Leo. Let’s show the world the real Midnight Lotus.

options.label: Ask if it’s a business trip or a first date

nodes.text: Warm lamplight catches the gold leaf on the painting as you lock the gallery doors together.
First stop: Paris. Next stop: everywhere.
Leo’s grin turns soft and unmistakable as he offers you his arm.
Definitely both—if you’ll allow it, {{player_name}}.
Your mother’s gallery stands unburned, unmortgaged, and eternal.
Some treasures can’t be forged—and neither can a second life.

nodes.headline: Masterpiece Unbroken · Finale
nodes.teaser_text: Up next: Paris Opening Night — Louvre-adjacent pavilion in Paris.

nodes.text: 8:00 PM · Louvre-adjacent pavilion in Paris. Your mother’s Midnight Lotus hangs in honor—illuminated before the world’s finest curators.
They just added a permanent plaque in your mother’s name—and a scholarship for young women painters.
From a burning basement to Paris. Not bad for waking up at 6:30 PM.
Don’t forget to look at the Seine view after the speech!

nodes.transcript: [warm cheers in background] "The curator is calling your name, {{player_name}}. Take the spotlight!"

nodes.prompt: You step beneath the golden Paris lights:

options.label: Raise your glass to your mother’s memory
options.player_reply_text: For Mom—whose light outlasted every shadow.

options.label: Take Leo’s hand & bow to the Paris crowd

nodes.text: A standing ovation swells through the stone gallery halls.
Unforgettable night, {{player_name}}.
Leo squeezes your hand gently as cameras capture the brightest new chapter of your life.
To a lifetime of real masterpieces—together.
The ashes of your past life are gone. Only gold remains.
I woke up to save a painting—and ended up saving my whole soul.

nodes.headline: Eternal Canvas · Finale
nodes.teaser_text: Your mother’s masterpiece hangs beside the Seine in Paris — every forgery shattered, every legacy restored.
